faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MDU Rohtak Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Assistant position at Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak is August 17, 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Assistant position, candidates must have a B.Sc and M.Sc degree in Life Science with a minimum of 55% marks. NET or equivalent is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the MDU Rohtak Project Assistant job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents via email to the address specified in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant role involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant position at MDU Rohtak is scheduled to be held on August 18, 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak located?
faq.answer: Maharshi Dayanand University is located in Rohtak, Haryana, with the pincode 124001.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant position at MDU Rohtak is a contractual role.
